title: TransactionPaymentReferenceNumberResponse
description: This is the response that is returned upon successful Retrieval of a Payment Reference Number for a transaction.

TransactionPaymentReferenceNumber.description: This will hold the payment reference number that will be sent back in the response for a transaction.

roleType.description: This is the type of tax payment that the client is obligated to make payments for to the ATO.

transactionId.description: This is the Transaction ID identifier that the taxpayer uses to make payments to the ATO.

paymentReferenceNumber.description:
This is up to an 18 digit code to define the payment. A number which payment processing will use to determine
where a client's payment will be allocated.
